annotations.title: Measured price reaction to a filing

description: How the market actually moved after ONE announcement: percentage moves at 5 and 30 minutes from the announcement-minute price, and on the reaction day (the first session that could trade the news), the next day, 2/3/5/7/15 sessions and 1/2/3 months from the close before the filing. For each daily window it also gives the size index's move and the industry peers' median move over the same two closes, and the excess against each in percentage points. Measured data, not a forecast, and never a claim that the filing caused the move — no other Indian data source publishes it. Get an alert id from recent_alerts first. Factual data only — MarketPing publishes no buy/sell recommendations, no price targets and no IPO grey-market premium.
